title.zh: 宣布每年 12 月 8 日为安赫莱斯市特别非工作假日，以纪念成立纪念日的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring December Eight of Every Year A Special Nonworking Holiday in Angeles City in Commemoration of Its Foundation Day
title.orig: An Act Declaring December Eight of Every Year A Special Nonworking Holiday in Angeles City in Commemoration of Its Foundation Day

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1997/ra_8315_1997.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: December eight of every year is hereby declared a special nonworking holiday in Angeles City in commemoration of its foundation day.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
